title: Aave DAO launches GHO on Ethereum mainnet
description: Aave governance executed the GHO mainnet launch with the Aave V3 Ethereum Pool and FlashMinter as the initial facilitators, enabling collateral-backed GHO minting on Ethereum.
notes: The executed governance proposal provides the day-level launch date and initial facilitator set.

title: Liquity V2 relaunch makes BOLD live
description: Liquity V2's live deployment introduced BOLD as an Ethereum-native stablecoin backed by WETH, wstETH, and rETH branches with borrower-set interest rates and direct protocol redemption.
notes: The date follows Liquity's documented V2 relaunch reference after earlier deployment and redeployment work.

title: Usual launches its public mainnet with USD0 live
description: Usual announced on 9 July 2024 that its public mainnet had launched, with USD0 and USD0++ available for participation in the public Pills campaign.
notes: The canonical boundary is unrestricted public-mainnet availability; earlier May 2024 introduction and permissioned activity remain pre-public context.

title: Unauthorized USR minting incident places Resolv operations into recovery
description: Resolv reported an unauthorized minting incident involving USR. The protocol stated that the collateral pool remained intact, paused most operations, and began containment, token invalidation, holder compensation, investigation, and recovery work.
notes: SOG records the unauthorized mint, operational restriction, and recovery state without treating the incident as proof that underlying collateral was lost.

title: Resolv opens USR to public participation
description: Resolv opened its points program to the crypto community on 4 September 2024 with live USR holding, staking, liquidity, and trading activities; a later first-party anniversary statement identifies that date as the public launch.
notes: The public-launch date is distinct from the March 2026 unauthorized-mint incident and recovery state.
